يلتحما (form VIII)
# يَلْتَحِمَا (yaltaḥimā) /jal.ta.ħi.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# يُلْتَحَمَا (yultaḥamā) /jul.ta.ħa.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
